_doc: Tasks for tools/e2e_bench.py. Placeholders {dir} (fresh temp dir of the run), {tag} (unique per run, in every window title) and {num} (random number) are replaced in files, prompt, wait_window and close_windows; shell steps get them as $TASK_DIR, $TAG and $NUM. A setup step that appends a PID to $TASK_DIR/.pids gets exactly that process killed afterwards (only while its command line still names $TASK_DIR). close_windows closes the window whose title contains the text through desktop-mcp's close_window (single-instance apps). check.python is an expression over dir, tag, num, result (the agent's final text) and read(path), exists(path), lines(path), mcp(tool, **args) (read-only desktop-mcp tools only).

tasks.summary: type a line at the end of an open Kate document and save
tasks.prompt: The desktop tools are available. Kate has the file notes-{tag}.txt open. Add the line "olive oil 2L" as the last line of that document and save the file.

tasks.summary: Save As the Kate document under a new path (file dialog)
tasks.prompt: The desktop tools are available. Kate has the file report-{tag}.txt open. Save a copy of it as {dir}/final-{tag}.txt using Kate's Save As.

tasks.summary: search and replace a word in Kate, then save

files.style-{tag}.txt:
The colour of the header is blue.
Pick a colour for the footer.
No other changes.
The default colour is grey.

tasks.prompt: The desktop tools are available. Kate has the file style-{tag}.txt open. Replace every "colour" in it with "color" and save the file.

check.python: lines(f'{dir}/style-{tag}.txt') == ['The color of the header is blue.', 'Pick a color for the footer.', 'No other changes.', 'The default color is grey.']

tasks.summary: read a value from a Kate document and answer it

files.service-{tag}.ini:
[server]
host = 10.0.0.7
port = 8080
connect_timeout_ms = 250

[client]
retries = 3
timeout_ms = {num}
user_agent = probe/1.2

tasks.prompt: The desktop tools are available. Kate has the file service-{tag}.ini open. What is the client's timeout_ms in it? Answer with just the number.

tasks.summary: fill two fields of a local web form in Firefox and submit it

files.form-{tag}.html: Event sign-up

tasks.prompt: The desktop tools are available. Firefox shows a sign-up form in the window titled "Sign-up {tag}". Fill in Full name with "Ada Lovelace" and City with "London", leave Note empty, and submit the form.

check.python: f'Submitted {tag}: Ada Lovelace / London' in mcp('windows', query=tag)

tasks.summary: create a folder in the folder Dolphin shows
tasks.prompt: The desktop tools are available. Dolphin shows the folder box-{tag}. Create a new folder named archive-{tag} inside it.
